column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:time-util module
# Loadable module of time/date utilities. Its name collides with the
# builtin `Time` type, so it carries a `-util` id and a `TimeUtil`
# namespace: `"aql:time-util" import end  TimeUtil.word args`. The module
# distinguishes Instant (a point in time, e.g. a unix timestamp) from
# Date (a calendar day) — Date-typed words (to-iso, is-leap-year, …) take
# a Date, not an Instant. The "current time" words (today-utc, now-local)
# read the Clock capability, which this suite FREEZES at 2021-01-01, so
# they are deterministic here. (Core `now` is in lang/spec/temporal.tsv.)
# §2  current day — frozen at 2021-01-01 in this suite
